claims.nodeLabel: National Security Act of 1947 (Pub. L. 80-253, 61 Stat. 495)
claims.sourceText: National Security Act of 1947 sec. 102(a), 61 Stat. 497, https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/STATUTE-61/pdf/STATUTE-61-Pg495.pdf
claims.text: Section 102(a): 'There is hereby established under the National Security Council a Central Intelligence Agency with a Director of Central Intelligence'. The Agency is created UNDER the Council, not beside it.

a.label: National Security Act of 1947 (Pub. L. 80-253, 61 Stat. 495)

edges.label: Section 102(a) creates the Agency, under the Council
edges.note: 'There is hereby established under the National Security Council a Central Intelligence Agency with a Director of Central Intelligence'. The preposition is the point: the Agency sits under the Council.
